title: Silver Flag Live Fire Burn Pit
description:
Video highlighting the live fire burn pit conducted by the 801st Red Horse Training Squadron at Silver Flag, Tyndall Air Force Base, Florida.
(U.S. Air Force video by Airman Zeeshan Naeem)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Airman Zeeshan Naeem

transcript.text: So Silver Flag is important because it teaches Airmen how to be in a deployment location,
It teaches Airmen how it would be in a in-country station where you have all the resources
It teaches us how we would do things a little bit differently.
And we have of course the fire pit, which is the only fire pit in the DOD that is able
to use live jet-a fuel and home.
The Marines haven't been here in decades and I think that we need to start sending Marines
here to do more joint training.
I think it's important for the Marines to train with Airmen to build that commodity
and spread knowledge between each other this way we could be better prepared for deployment.
My experience with the live burns was amazing.
Being able to use H-FFLF as well as actually practicing technique with live cars.
I got a lot of knowledge and got to talk to a lot of the Airmen who gave me that knowledge
and I'm going to be able to take it back with me and spread it to the Marines.

pass_reason: mostly interviews; about 10 s of fire, no outcome
